description: This file implements higher-order map operations in PyTorch, including a MapImpl class, a map function with autograd support, and various mode-specific implementations. It defines the MapAutogradOp class for autograd functionality and includes utilities for tracing and functionalization.

classes.name: MapImpl
classes.description: A class representing the map implementation, inheriting from HigherOrderOperator, encapsulating the core map logic.

classes.name: MapAutogradOp
classes.description: A custom autograd Function for the map operation supporting forward and backward passes.

methods.name: map
methods.description: Performs a map operation over input tensors or pytrees, applying a function f to each slice along the first dimension.

methods.name: map_dense
methods.description: Implementation of map for dense tensor modes, applying function f to unstacked tensors.

methods.name: map_autograd
methods.description: Autograd-enabled map function utilizing MapAutogradOp for differentiation.

methods.name: map_functionalize
methods.description: Functionalized version of map supporting context-based tensor wrapping.
